title: users left open (couchdb) — review required
description: users runs with an open setting: require_valid_users*=s*false. Open binds, trust auth, and disabled protections expose the service to unauthenticated networks. This lexical rule flags the setting; the reviewer confirms isolation or hardens it.
remediation: Apply true plus admin accounts and verify from an untrusted network.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the setting regardless of network isolation.
